translations.web: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
translations.bsb: When the Council members heard this, they were enraged, and they resolved to put the apostles to death.
translations.kjv: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
translations.asv: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and minded to slay them.
